note: a bare string cannot end with a comma
a bare string cannot begin with a comma
a bare string cannot end with a pipe
a bare string cannot end with a quotelike character
an apostrophe is quotelike, so it cannot end one either
a backtick is quotelike, and would also read as a multiline opener
a table cell holds a bare string and the same first-character rule applies in it
and the same last-character rule applies in it
no bare element may sit in a comma-packed array as of spec v0.5.0
a bare string cannot begin with a square bracket -- '[ ' opens an array level and MINIMAL JSON opens with '['
a bare string cannot end with a square bracket -- it reads as an array or MINIMAL JSON closing
the rule is not sided: a closing square bracket is barred at the start too
the rule is not sided: an opening square bracket is barred at the end too
a bare string cannot begin with a curly bracket -- '{ ' opens an object level
a bare string cannot end with a curly bracket
a squarebracketlike character counts, not only the ASCII one
a curlybracketlike character counts at the end too
a fold marker left of the value it would continue is not a continuation at all -- the parser names the column it belongs in
a fold marker on an odd column cannot be in any value's column
same rule for a folded key: the marker has to be in the key's own column
a fold marker two columns too far right continues nothing either -- the column is the value's own, not merely an even one
same test behind a nesting marker, where the value's column is the indent plus two for the marker
a table row must start at the column the table's first row set; the offending indent is named as the fault rather than being read as content
a closing indent glyph sits at the indent of the line that opened the frame; at any other column it closes nothing, and its indent is named as the fault rather than read as content
every line of one multiline shares the margin column its first line set; a line whose '|' is elsewhere is not a margin line at all
a bold multiline margin that moves: the pipe that is out of line is the fault, and it is named
a table row whose cell edges do not line up with the header's: the row's own pipe carries the fault
a closing indent glyph away from the column its frame opened at
a bare key may not end with a space (rule 4)
a bare key may not contain two consecutive spaces (rule 5)
a bare key may not end with a comma (rule 4, commalike)
a bare key may not end with an apostrophe (rule 4, quotelike) -- one inside is fine
packing needs an array open, and gap 0 after a colon is a single empty array -- this is not a packed array at all

a bare key may not contain a colonlike character (rule 6). U+02D0 MODIFIER LETTER TRIANGULAR COLON is the only one of the twenty that is a letter, so it is the only one the whitelist would otherwise have let through
a bare key may not contain a default-ignorable character (rule 7). U+115F HANGUL CHOSEONG FILLER is a letter, so \p{L} admitted it and it is invisible, which is the whole reason the rule exists
